system.description:
Mop Master. +1 Talent Die when fighting with improvised weapons. Improvised weapons deal +1 damage, or +2 if the weapon is a mop.

Clean Freak (Flaw). Minor Disadvantage on all Skill Checks while covered in grime or in a filthy environment.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.89
